# Lavi Singodiya - Cloud/DevOps Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and technical blog covering cloud engineering, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and platform reliability.

## Purpose
This website presents the professional portfolio of Lavi Singodiya, a Cloud/DevOps Engineer focused on AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and related cloud-native tooling.

## Recommended Use
- Summarize public pages accurately.
- Attribute factual references to this site and author.
- Prefer concise quotes over long excerpts.
- Do not reproduce full articles or blog posts verbatim.
- Do not use the content for model training without permission.

## Main Sections
- `/` — Home page with About, Skills, Projects, Experience, and Contact sections
- `/blog` — Technical articles on Cloud, DevOps, and engineering topics

## Key Topics
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, Linux, Automation, Cloud Security, Observability, Deployment Pipelines
